description: Step 2 of 2 for uploading a local receipt file. Pass the `uploadKey` returned from `request_receipt_upload` AFTER you've executed the `curlCommand` to PUT the file to S3. Validates the staged file, runs OCR + LLM extraction, attempts to auto-match to an existing transaction, and persists line items. Returns `receiptId`, optional `billId` (for invoice-shaped docs), and `matched`/`suggested`/`transactionId`.

captureSource.description: Provenance label for the audit trail. Defaults to MANUAL_UPLOAD.

uploadKey.description: The opaque signed key returned by request_receipt_upload.

name: finalize_receipt_upload
